name: Easy Pet Obby
desc:
⚠️ The game is currently in BETA, if you see any bugs please report them to us and we'll fix them immediately! ⚠️

✨Welcome to Easy Pet Obby!

Become different animals to help you conquer different challenges! This fun, colorful easy obby needs a champion like yourself to get the pets to the finish line!

Worm: Can fit through small holes!
Spider: Can climb walls!
Chicken: Can glide through the sky!
Kangaroo: Can jump super high!
Bear: Can break down walls!

❤️ Made by RoyalFire Studios!
